String value showing the subtotal amount and tax amount from the posting. The two values are separated by a semicolon. Example: <OtherEventMemo>345.23;23.34</OtherEventMemo>

String value containing the following information separated by semi colons.
• ReviewerAction
• EstimatorAction
• LinesAdded
• LinesRemoved
• LinesModified
• SupplementTotalAmount
Example: <OtherEventMemo>ReviewerAction:Approve with Changes;EstimatorAction:Accept and Lock;LinesAdded:2; LinesRemoved:1;LinesModified:3; SupplementTotalAmount:150</OtherEventMemo>
• For Central Review Statis:
The current central review status description for the workfile. Possible values:
• Ready for review
• Review complete
